newsitem.title: USA: N. Amer. Vaccine sees no more CERTIVA trials.
newsitem.headline: N. Amer. Vaccine sees no more CERTIVA trials.

text.p: North American Vaccine on Tuesday said it continues to believe that no additional clinical studies will be required regarding its CERTIVA product license application.

The company issued a statement in response to what it termed "numerous inaccurate reports" of conclusions on the drug reached by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration's Vaccines and Biological Products Advisory Committee.

The company said that, contrary to the "inaccurate" reports, various members of the advisory committee found CERTIVA -- a drug used to treat diphtheria, tetanus and whooping couch -- was safe and effective for administration to infants at various stages of their development.
The company said, however, that because the committee's views are not binding on the FDA, it can make no assurances that the FDA will not require additional clinical trials for the drug.
North American Vaccine officials were not immediately available to comment.
